description: Some jobs, like the credentialed construction-safety jobs in Los Angeles, are open only to a person whose credential a human has checked, and some credentials have no public lookup at all. This is how a CHST or STS (BCSP) gets on record, and how a record-only credential such as the Living Future Accredited (issuer ILFI, credential LFA) is signed into the public registry at GET /labor/credential-registry. FREE, a signed statement, no fee, no gas, no money moves. You give the issuer, the credential, your name exactly as the issuer shows it, the certificate number exactly as the issuer shows it (required for a CHST or STS, left out for an LFA), and the expiry date if a CHST or STS shows one. A CHST or STS lands PENDING: a person reads the issuer's public lookup and marks it checked or not found, and only a checked record inside its dates opens a credentialed job. A record-only credential opens no job whatever its label: you say listPublicly true in your signed words, it is listed with ONE label (self-declared, which stays self-declared if you add certificateSha256, the SHA-256 of your own certificate file, and a published anchor batch later holds that hash: it shows only that a document with those bytes existed by a date, never that you own it; or confirmed by the issuer, after a person at a terminal checks a saved email the issuer's own mail domain signed, the only label that is a check), and it is an independent record, not an official verification by the issuer. Nothing on this server can mark any record checked. The certificate number and the name stay private; never send a phone number, an email or an address. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with that wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_credential_record within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

certificateNumber.description: The number printed on the certificate, exactly as the issuer's lookup shows it. Required for a CHST or STS; leave out for an LFA, which carries none. Never a phone number or an email.

certificateSha256.description: Optional, record-only credentials only: the 64-character SHA-256 of your own certificate file (shasum -a 256 <file>). The file itself is never sent.

credential.description: The credential: CHST or STS for BCSP, LFA for ILFI.

expiresOn.description: Optional, CHST and STS only: the date the certificate runs out, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out if it shows none, and always for a record-only credential.

holderName.description: Your name exactly as the issuer shows it. A person matches it against the issuer's lookup or the issuer's email; it is kept private.

issuer.description: The body that issued the credential: BCSP, or ILFI for the Living Future Accredited. GET /labor/credential-registry lists every issuer the board takes.

listPublicly.description: Required as true for a record-only credential such as the LFA: your own signed yes to being listed in the public registry. Leave out for a CHST or STS.

workerWallet.description: The 0x… address that signs. Address only, never a private key.
